purpose: Use a circumstance as a convenient pretext for another aim.
keywords: He used his business trip as a pretext to visit a hot spring.
She used the inspection as an excuse to peek into the room.
I used the birthday as an excuse to buy something I wanted.
restrictions: The stated reason does not fully explain the real motive.
mistake: It often implies opportunism, unlike neutral を機に.
